name: dsh-molbio-tools
description: Zero-dependency molecular-biology plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: sequence analysis, primer design (incl. cross-intron qPCR primers, TaqMan hydrolysis probes and multiplex compatibility), in-silico PCR, cloning simulation, SnapGene .dna parsing and plasmid maps, Sanger verification, protein tools (incl. helical wheel and hydropathy plots), methylation-aware restriction analysis with double-digest buffer checks, qPCR analysis and plotting, multiple sequence alignment that conserves every input residue, conservation analysis, sequence logos, codon-usage analysis, phylogenetic trees with bootstrap support, Newick I/O and long-name label wrapping, CpG-island/GC-skew composition analysis, read-level FASTQ QC, CRISPR gRNA design with off-target search, an opt-in hand-off that shows a generated plot to the model as an attached image, plus a browser-side right-sidebar panel (plasmid maps and sequence logos drawn in the Web GUI) and a literature/protocol/experiment record system.

scripts.test: node --run test:unit && node test/contract.mjs && node test/drift-probe.mjs && node test/preset-health.mjs && node test/benchmark-profile.mjs && node test/benchmark-score.mjs && node --run bench:offline
scripts.test:unit: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/svgpng.mjs && node test/svgio.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node test/panel-render.mjs && node test/map-card.mjs && node test/client-mount.mjs
scripts.test:client:node: node test/client.mjs && node test/panel-render.mjs && node test/map-card.mjs && node test/client-mount.mjs
